name: io.github.langmail/caldav-mcp
description: CalDAV calendar operations (list, create, update, delete events) as MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the CalDAV server (e.g. https://caldav.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: CALDAV_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated account names (e.g. personal,family) to serve several CalDAV accounts; each needs CALDAV_<NAME>_BASE_URL, _USERNAME and _PASSWORD, and the three variables above are then ignored
